whole_image_detector.description: Whole-image yolox traffic light detector. model_path / label_path are relative to ml_model_path; roi_remap_path is injected by the launch file (it ships in autoware_tensorrt_yolox's share directory, not under ml_model_path) and so is absent here.

model_path.description: Path to the detector's ONNX model, relative to ml_model_path.

label_path.description: Path to the detector's class label file, relative to ml_model_path.

score_threshold.description: Detection score threshold for the whole-image yolox detector.

nms_threshold.description: NMS threshold for the whole-image yolox detector.

precision.description: TensorRT engine precision. int8 is calibrated with the Entropy algorithm and a fixed clip value, so it needs no calibration image list.

min_timestamp_offset.description: Minimum timestamp offset when searching for the corresponding map->camera tf sample.

max_timestamp_offset.description: Maximum timestamp offset when searching for the corresponding map->camera tf sample.

model_path.description: Path to the classifier's ONNX model, relative to ml_model_path.

label_path.description: Path to the classifier's lamp label file, relative to ml_model_path.

precision.description: TensorRT engine precision for this classifier.

mean.description: Per-channel mean subtracted from the input image. Must match the normalization the model at model_path was trained with, so change it together with model_path.

std.description: Per-channel standard deviation the input image is divided by. Must match the normalization the model at model_path was trained with, so change it together with model_path.

model_path.description: Path to the classifier's ONNX model, relative to ml_model_path.

label_path.description: Path to the classifier's lamp label file, relative to ml_model_path.

precision.description: TensorRT engine precision for this classifier.

mean.description: Per-channel mean subtracted from the input image. Must match the normalization the model at model_path was trained with, so change it together with model_path.

std.description: Per-channel standard deviation the input image is divided by. Must match the normalization the model at model_path was trained with, so change it together with model_path.

over_exposure_threshold.description: ROI mean-intensity threshold above which the ROI is treated as over-exposed and classified as UNKNOWN. Shared by car_classifier and pedestrian_classifier: both classify ROIs cropped from the same camera image, so this is a property of the camera, not of either classifier individually.

under_exposure_threshold.description: ROI mean-intensity threshold below which the ROI is treated as under-exposed and classified as UNKNOWN. Shared by car_classifier and pedestrian_classifier for the same reason as over_exposure_threshold.

build_only.description: Build the TensorRT engines for the whole-image detector and the classifiers and exit, without waiting for the vector map.

ml_model_path.description: Directory holding the ML artifacts the model_path / label_path values below are relative to. Supplied by the launch file, so this package's config file names no user-specific path.
